# Filters

Small functions you can use inside Nunjucks templates, like `{{ value | filterName }}`.

## What's here

- `string.js`: markdown, truncating, case
- `array.js`: group, sort, unique, sum
- `date.js`: readable dates
- `color.js`: blend and convert hex colors
- `dom.js`: pull headings out of HTML
- `file.js`: file sizes and inline SVG
- `image.js`: find an image by id
- `filters.js`: registers them all

## How it connects

- Registered from `eleventy.config.js`; used across `views/`.
